Provenance.drafts: Every townsfolk body is a COMPOSITE, matching the six-hero-cast wave's own convention (art/build/town2d-hero-*.build.json): a stage-1 t2i base (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl LoRA @1.0/1.0, 30 steps, cfg 7.0, dpmpp_2m/karras, 832x1216, batch of 4) picks one candidate; non-robed bodies (broad, belder, slight, steen) then get a SEPARATE walk-contact inpaint per side (SetLatentNoiseMask, denoise 0.5, same sampler/scheduler) for the two weight-bearing gait frames, with the two passing frames a same-render pixel sway of the adopted base -- no extra diffusion sample. ROBED bodies (bmatron, selder) have no visible legs and use the hand pipeline's own no-diffusion hem-sway idiom for ALL FOUR frames: no separate walk-contact render was ever generated for them (the art job's own folk_geom.json entries for bmatron/selder carry no walk seed at all, unlike the other four bodies). All rejected candidates are kept MISS-prefixed under the job's own tmp/folk/_work/ folder (gen_folk_bases.py, gen_folk_bases2.py, gen_folk_walks.py, assemble_folk.py, folk_geom.json).
